cards.q: Actus reus: when can an omission (failure to act) support criminal liability?
cards.qZh: 犯罪行为要件：不作为在什么情况下可以构成刑事责任？
cards.a: The act must be voluntary (not reflex, unconsciousness, or seizure). An omission suffices only if: (1) a legal duty exists — from statute, contract, status relationship, voluntary assumption of care that isolates the victim, or defendant's creation of the peril; (2) defendant knew the facts triggering the duty; and (3) performance was reasonably possible.
cards.aZh: 行为必须出于自愿（反射动作、无意识状态、癫痫发作不算）。不作为仅在以下情形构成犯罪：(1)存在法律义务——来自制定法、合同、特定身份关系、自愿承担照料并使被害人与外界隔离、或被告自己制造了危险；(2)被告知悉触发义务的事实；(3)履行义务具有现实可能性。
cards.explainZh: 美国法无一般救助义务——路人见死不救原则上无罪，这与中国司法实践中较宽的先行行为义务认定不同。记忆五种义务来源：法定/合同/身份关系/自愿承担/自创危险。
cards.mnemonic: Duty sources: Statute, Contract, Status, Assumption, Peril-creation

cards.q: Contrast the common law mens rea categories with the MPC hierarchy.
cards.qZh: 比较普通法的犯罪意图分类与《模范刑法典》(MPC)的四级体系。
cards.a: Common law: specific intent (intent to achieve a further result — inchoate crimes, assault, larceny, robbery, burglary, forgery, false pretenses, embezzlement, first-degree premeditated murder); general intent (awareness of the criminal act); malice (murder, arson). MPC: purposely, knowingly, recklessly, negligently — and if the statute is silent, recklessness is the default minimum.
cards.aZh: 普通法：特定故意（追求进一步结果的意图——未完成罪、攻击罪、盗窃、抢劫、入室罪、伪造、诈骗取财、侵占、一级预谋谋杀）；一般故意（对行为本身的认识）；恶意（谋杀、纵火）。MPC：蓄意、明知、轻率、疏忽四级——法条未规定时，默认最低要求为轻率。
cards.explainZh: 中国《刑法》只分故意（直接/间接）与过失（疏忽大意/过于自信）；MPC更细：purposely≈直接故意，knowingly≈间接故意/明知，recklessly介于放任与过于自信过失之间，negligently≈疏忽大意过失。特定故意清单是醉酒抗辩、事实错误的门票，必须背熟。
cards.mnemonic: Specific intent: FIAT — First-degree murder, Inchoate (attempt/solicitation/conspiracy), Assault, Theft-type crimes

cards.q: When do mistake of fact and mistake of law excuse criminal liability?
cards.qZh: 事实错误与法律错误分别在什么情况下可以免责？
cards.a: Mistake of fact: negates a specific-intent crime even if unreasonable; must be reasonable to negate general intent; never excuses strict liability. Mistake of law: generally no defense, except (1) reasonable reliance on an official statement of law later held invalid, (2) statute not reasonably made available, or (3) knowledge of the law is itself an element of the offense.
cards.aZh: 事实错误：对特定故意犯罪，即使错误不合理也可排除故意；对一般故意犯罪，错误须合理；对严格责任犯罪永远不能免责。法律错误：原则上不是辩护理由，例外：(1)合理信赖后来被宣告无效的官方法律解释；(2)法律未合理公布；(3)明知违法本身是犯罪构成要件。
cards.explainZh: 记忆矩阵：特定故意+任何真诚错误=免责；一般故意+合理错误=免责；严格责任+任何错误=不免责。'不知法律不免责'与中国通说一致，但美国的三项例外更明确。

cards.q: Under transferred intent, if D aims at A but hits B, D's intent transfers to the unintended victim — but only within {{c::the same crime}}; intent to commit one offense never transfers to a different offense.
cards.qZh: 根据故意转移原则，被告瞄准甲却击中乙时，其故意转移至意外被害人——但仅限于____；针对一罪的故意不会转移到另一种罪名。
cards.a: the same crime
cards.aZh: 同一罪名
cards.explainZh: 经典陷阱：D欲枪杀甲误杀乙，对乙成立谋杀，同时对甲仍成立谋杀未遂——故意不会被'用尽'。中国刑法以打击错误/法定符合说处理，结论相同。注意故意不能从'砸窗'转移到'伤人'，跨罪名不转移。

cards.q: Dan takes an umbrella from a restaurant rack, honestly but unreasonably believing it is his own. Charged with larceny, Dan's best argument is:
cards.qZh: 丹从餐厅伞架取走一把伞，真诚但不合理地相信那是自己的伞。被控盗窃罪时，他最有力的抗辩是：
choices: His mistake is no defense because it was unreasonable.
His honest mistake negates the specific intent to steal, however unreasonable.
Mistake of fact never applies to property crimes.
He is guilty unless he returned the umbrella promptly.
cards.explain: Larceny is a specific-intent crime: any honest mistake of fact — reasonable or not — negates the intent to permanently deprive another of property. Reasonableness matters only for general-intent crimes.
cards.explainZh: 盗窃是特定故意犯罪：只要真诚相信财物属于自己（哪怕不合理），就没有非法占有他人财物的故意。「不合理即无抗辩」一项把一般故意的'合理性'要求错用于特定故意；「须及时归还」一项错在事后归还与否不影响犯罪成立。中国法同理：无非法占有目的不构成盗窃罪。

cards.q: Planning to kill Vic that night, Don drives toward Vic's house. En route his car skids on ice and kills a pedestrian — who turns out to be Vic. Don's liability for premeditated murder?
cards.qZh: 唐计划当晚杀死维克，驾车前往其住所。途中车辆在冰面打滑，撞死一名行人——事后发现正是维克。唐是否构成预谋谋杀？
choices: Guilty: he intended Vic's death and caused it.
Guilty: driving toward the house was a substantial step.
Not guilty of murder: his intent did not actuate the act that killed.
Not guilty of any homicide offense as a matter of law.
cards.explain: Concurrence requires the mens rea to actuate the actus reus; the accidental skid, not the murderous plan, caused death. Involuntary manslaughter remains possible only if his driving was criminally negligent.
cards.explainZh: 同时性原则(concurrence)：杀人故意必须驱动致死行为，巧合结果不归责于预谋。「驶向住宅已是实质步骤」一项混淆了未遂的'实质步骤'与既遂归责；「一律不构成任何杀人罪」一项太绝对——若驾驶行为有刑事过失，仍可能构成过失杀人。中国刑法'主客观相统一'原则思路相同。

cards.q: What conduct and mental state make someone an accomplice, and what is the innocent-instrumentality rule?
cards.qZh: 何种行为与主观状态构成共犯？'无辜工具'规则是什么？
cards.a: An accomplice aids, encourages, or counsels the principal with (1) intent to assist and (2) intent that the crime succeed; he is then liable for the crime itself. Mere knowledge is insufficient (majority), though a seller charging a premium for known criminal use may qualify. One who acts through an innocent agent (child, insane or deceived person) is himself the principal.
cards.aZh: 共犯是指以(1)帮助的意图和(2)希望犯罪得逞的意图，对正犯予以帮助、鼓励或出谋划策的人，须对该犯罪本身承担责任。仅仅知情不构成共犯（多数规则），但明知用于犯罪而加价出售者可能构成。利用无辜工具（儿童、精神病人、受蒙骗者）实施犯罪的人本身就是正犯。
cards.explainZh: 双重意图是考点：既要有意帮助，又要希望犯罪成功。对比中国《刑法》第25条共同犯罪须'共同故意'，思路相近；利用无责任能力人犯罪在中国称间接正犯，结论一致。

cards.q: Beyond the crime he aided, for what additional crimes is an accomplice liable?
cards.qZh: 除其帮助的犯罪外，共犯还须对哪些额外犯罪负责？
cards.a: Majority rule: an accomplice is liable for all crimes that are the natural and probable (reasonably foreseeable) consequences of the crime he aided. Minority/MPC: liable only for offenses he actually intended to assist.
cards.aZh: 多数规则：共犯对其所帮助犯罪的自然且可能（可合理预见）的后果性犯罪均须负责。少数/MPC规则：仅对其实际有意帮助的犯罪负责。
cards.explainZh: 例：帮助入室盗窃，同伙在屋内持枪抢劫——抢劫是可预见后果，共犯也构成抢劫。加州已废除该原则在谋杀罪中的适用（见加州注释）。
cards.caNote: SB 1437 (effective 2019) abolished natural-and-probable-consequences liability for murder in California: a murder accomplice must personally act with malice or satisfy the narrowed felony-murder rule.
cards.caNoteZh: SB 1437法案（2019年生效）废除了加州谋杀罪的'自然可能后果'共犯责任：谋杀共犯必须本人具有恶意，或符合收窄后的重罪谋杀规则。

cards.q: How does an accomplice effectively withdraw before the crime occurs?
cards.qZh: 共犯如何在犯罪发生前有效退出？
cards.a: Withdrawal must come before the chain of events becomes unstoppable. One who merely encouraged must repudiate the encouragement to the principal; one who gave material aid must neutralize it (retrieve it or render it ineffective); alternatively, timely notification to police or other action to prevent the crime suffices. Silent flight or non-participation is not enough.
cards.aZh: 退出必须发生在事态尚可阻止之前。仅提供鼓励者须向正犯撤回鼓励；提供实质帮助者须使帮助归于无效（取回或使其失效）；或者及时报警、采取其他阻止犯罪的行动。默默离开或不再参与不构成有效退出。
cards.explainZh: 对比中国《刑法》第24条共犯中止：须有效防止犯罪结果发生才成立中止——中国标准更严（要求结果不发生），美国只要求消除自己的贡献。

cards.q: {{c::Mere presence at the scene, or mere knowledge that a crime will be committed}}, does not create accomplice liability; the defendant must act to aid or encourage with intent that the offense succeed.
cards.qZh: ____不产生共犯责任；被告必须以希望犯罪得逞的意图实施帮助或鼓励行为。
cards.a: Mere presence at the scene, or mere knowledge that a crime will be committed
cards.aZh: 仅在犯罪现场出现，或仅知晓犯罪将要发生
cards.explainZh: MBE高频陷阱：旁观者看着朋友行窃而不阻止≠共犯（无救助/阻止义务）。但若事先约定到场'壮胆'，到场本身就是鼓励，构成共犯。

cards.q: After Rob completes an armed bank robbery and flees, his sister Ann — learning what he did — hides him in her attic for a week. Ann is guilty of:
cards.qZh: 罗布完成持械抢劫银行并逃跑后，其姐安得知实情，将他藏在阁楼一周。安构成何罪？
choices: Accessory after the fact, a separate obstruction-type offense.
Robbery, as an accomplice.
Robbery, under the natural-and-probable-consequences doctrine.
No crime: family members are always exempt.
cards.explain: Aid rendered only after the felony is complete makes one an accessory after the fact — a distinct, lesser offense against justice — not a party to the robbery itself. Some statutes exempt certain close relatives, but that is not the general rule.
cards.explainZh: 犯罪既遂后才提供的帮助不构成共犯，而是独立的'事后从犯'（妨害司法类轻罪）。对比中国《刑法》第310条窝藏、包庇罪同样独立成罪。「抢劫共犯」与「自然可能后果」两项错在共犯责任须在犯罪完成前形成；「亲属一律豁免」一项错在亲属豁免仅个别州承认，非普遍规则。

cards.q: Solicitation: elements and merger.
cards.qZh: 教唆罪：构成要件与吸收关系。
cards.a: Asking, encouraging, or commanding another to commit a crime, with intent that it be committed. The offense is complete the moment the request is made — refusal is irrelevant. Merger: if the other agrees, solicitation merges into conspiracy; if the crime is attempted or completed, it merges into that offense, with the solicitor liable as an accomplice.
cards.aZh: 以希望犯罪实施的意图，请求、鼓励或命令他人实施犯罪。请求一经作出即告既遂——对方拒绝与否无关紧要。吸收：对方同意则教唆被共谋吸收；犯罪被着手或完成，则被该罪吸收，教唆人以共犯论处。
cards.explainZh: 美国法中教唆是独立的既遂罪，被教唆者拒绝也成立；中国《刑法》第29条教唆犯是共犯形态，被教唆者未犯罪时'可以从轻或减轻处罚'——结构完全不同，注意区分。

cards.q: Conspiracy: elements, common law vs. MPC agreement, overt act, and Wharton's rule.
cards.qZh: 共谋罪：构成要件、普通法与MPC的协议规则、外显行为及沃顿规则。
cards.a: (1) Agreement between two or more, (2) intent to agree, (3) intent to achieve the unlawful objective, plus in most states (4) any overt act, however slight (common law: agreement alone). CL bilateral: a feigned agreement (undercover officer) defeats conspiracy; MPC unilateral: one genuine agreer suffices. Wharton's rule: no conspiracy for crimes necessarily requiring two participants, absent extra parties.
cards.aZh: (1)两人以上达成协议，(2)有达成协议的故意，(3)有实现非法目标的故意，多数州另需(4)任何外显行为，无论多轻微（普通法仅需协议本身）。普通法双边规则：对方假意同意（卧底警察）则共谋不成立；MPC单边规则：一方真诚同意即可。沃顿规则：必须由两人实施的犯罪（决斗、行贿受贿）不另成立共谋，除非参与人数超过犯罪所必需。
cards.explainZh: 共谋罪是美国法独有利器，中国刑法无对应独立罪名（预备犯最接近但极少处罚）。考试常考卧底陷阱：普通法下与卧底'共谋'无罪，MPC下有罪。

cards.q: Pinkerton liability and the scope of a conspiracy (chain vs. wheel).
cards.qZh: 平克顿规则与共谋范围（链式与轮式共谋）。
cards.a: Pinkerton: each conspirator is liable for crimes of co-conspirators committed (1) in furtherance of the conspiracy and (2) reasonably foreseeable. Chain conspiracies (supplier–distributor–retailer) form one conspiracy because links share one venture; wheel (hub-and-spoke) arrangements are one conspiracy only if the spokes share a community of interest — otherwise multiple separate conspiracies. The MPC rejects Pinkerton, requiring true accomplice mens rea.
cards.aZh: 平克顿规则：每个共谋者对其他共谋者(1)为推进共谋且(2)可合理预见而实施的犯罪均须负责。链式共谋（供货—分销—零售）因各环节共享同一事业而构成一个共谋；轮式（轴辐式）结构仅在各辐条有共同利益时才是一个共谋，否则为多个独立共谋。MPC拒绝平克顿规则，要求真正的共犯主观要件。
cards.explainZh: 平克顿责任比共犯责任更宽：无需帮助、无需知情，只要可预见+推进共谋即归责。链式vs轮式决定'一罪还是数罪'及证据归属，毒品分销链是经典链式例子。

cards.q: Attempt: mental state, act requirement (CL vs. MPC), and abandonment.
cards.qZh: 犯罪未遂：主观要件、行为要件（普通法与MPC对比）及中途放弃。
cards.a: Attempt always requires specific intent to commit the target crime, plus an act beyond mere preparation: common law demands dangerous proximity to completion; the MPC/majority require a substantial step strongly corroborative of criminal purpose. Abandonment: no defense at common law once the attempt is underway; the MPC allows fully voluntary and complete renunciation. Attempt merges into the completed crime.
cards.aZh: 未遂罪始终要求实施目标犯罪的特定故意，加上超越预备的行为：普通法要求'危险地接近'既遂；MPC/多数州要求强烈印证犯罪目的的'实质步骤'。中途放弃：普通法下未遂一旦成立即无放弃抗辩；MPC承认完全自愿且彻底的放弃。未遂被既遂吸收。
cards.explainZh: 注意：即使目标罪是轻率型犯罪（如二级谋杀的漠视人命），未遂也须证明杀人的特定故意——'未遂的重罪谋杀'不存在。中国《刑法》第24条中止犯'应当免除或减轻处罚'，立场接近MPC而非普通法。

cards.q: Withdrawal from a conspiracy — communicated to all co-conspirators in time for them to abandon the plan — cuts off liability for {{c::co-conspirators' subsequent crimes}}, but is no defense to the conspiracy charge itself.
cards.qZh: 退出共谋——须及时通知所有共谋者使其有机会放弃计划——可以切断对____的责任，但对共谋罪本身不构成抗辩。
cards.a: co-conspirators' subsequent crimes
cards.aZh: 共谋者后续犯罪
cards.explainZh: 共谋在协议（+外显行为）时即既遂，之后退出为时已晚；退出只终止平克顿式的后续归责。MPC例外：主动挫败犯罪的'放弃'可作共谋罪抗辩。考试口诀：退出救未来，救不了共谋。

cards.q: Believing it contains cash, Pete slips his hand into Vic's coat pocket, which is in fact empty. At common law, Pete is:
cards.qZh: 皮特以为维克大衣口袋里有现金，伸手扒窃，但口袋实际是空的。依普通法，皮特：
choices: Not guilty of attempt: legal impossibility.
Not guilty of attempt: the crime could never have been completed.
Guilty of larceny.
Guilty of attempted larceny: factual impossibility is no defense.
cards.explain: When facts unknown to the defendant (an empty pocket) make completion impossible, that is factual impossibility — never a defense; had the facts been as he believed, larceny would have occurred. True legal impossibility — where the intended act is not criminal at all — remains a defense.
cards.explainZh: 事实不能（空口袋、枪未上膛）不是未遂的抗辩：假如事实如其所信，犯罪即成立。「法律不能」一项混淆了两种不能——'法律不能'指所欲行为根本不是犯罪（如'走私'实为合法商品）；「盗窃既遂」一项错在无既遂对象；「犯罪无法完成」一项是事实不能的另一种错误表述。中国刑法对象不能犯同样按未遂处理。

cards.q: Dan and Ed agree to rob a bank and then carry out the robbery. Dan is convicted of both conspiracy to rob and robbery. On appeal he argues the convictions merge. Result?
cards.qZh: 丹与埃德约定抢劫银行并实施了抢劫。丹被同时判共谋抢劫罪与抢劫罪，上诉主张两罪应吸收。结果如何？
choices: Both convictions reversed: inchoate offenses always merge.
Both convictions stand: conspiracy does not merge into the completed crime.
The conspiracy conviction is reversed under Wharton's rule.
The robbery conviction is reversed as duplicative.
cards.explain: Unlike solicitation and attempt, conspiracy punishes the distinct danger of group criminality and never merges into the completed offense; cumulative convictions are proper. Wharton's rule is inapplicable because robbery does not necessarily require two participants.
cards.explainZh: 吸收规则口诀：教唆、未遂被既遂吸收；共谋不吸收（团体危险独立可罚）。「沃顿规则」一项错在抢劫并非'必须二人'之罪，沃顿规则不适用；「未完成罪一律吸收」一项把三种未完成罪一概而论。中国无独立共谋罪，此为中美重大差异。
cards.mnemonic: Merger: Solicitation & Attempt merge; Conspiracy stands alone

cards.q: Define common law murder and the four mental states establishing malice aforethought.
cards.qZh: 普通法谋杀罪的定义及构成'预谋恶意'的四种主观状态。
cards.a: Murder is the unlawful killing of a human being with malice aforethought. Malice exists with any of: (1) intent to kill (express malice; use of a deadly weapon permits the inference); (2) intent to inflict great bodily injury; (3) depraved heart — reckless indifference to an unjustifiably high risk to human life; (4) the felony-murder rule.
cards.aZh: 谋杀是带有预谋恶意非法杀害他人。具备以下任一心态即有恶意：(1)杀人故意（明示恶意；使用致命武器可推定）；(2)重伤故意；(3)泯灭人性之心——对人命的极高风险漠然置之；(4)重罪谋杀规则。
cards.explainZh: '预谋恶意'是术语，不要求真正预谋或恶感。四种恶意是所有杀人题的分析起点：先问有无恶意定谋杀，再降格考虑非预谋杀人。中国刑法只分故意杀人/过失致人死亡，无四分恶意结构。
cards.mnemonic: Malice x4: Kill, Cripple (GBI), Callous (depraved heart), Crime (felony murder)

cards.q: First-degree vs. second-degree murder under typical statutes.
cards.qZh: 制定法下一级谋杀与二级谋杀的区分。
cards.a: First degree: killings that are premeditated and deliberate (a cool, reflective decision to kill — may form quickly), plus killings by poison, lying in wait, or torture, and felony murders predicated on enumerated felonies (burglary, arson, rape, robbery, kidnapping). Second degree: every other murder committed with malice — the statutory default.
cards.aZh: 一级谋杀：经预谋和深思的杀人（冷静、经反思的杀人决定——可在短时间内形成），以及投毒、伏击、酷刑杀人，和以列举重罪（入室、纵火、强奸、抢劫、绑架）为基础的重罪谋杀。二级谋杀：其他一切具有恶意的谋杀——法定默认档。
cards.explainZh: 预谋可以瞬间形成（'看一眼枪再开枪'即可），但醉酒可否定预谋从而降为二级（见辩护事由主题）。BARRK五罪是一级重罪谋杀的常考清单。
cards.mnemonic: BARRK felonies: Burglary, Arson, Rape, Robbery, Kidnapping

cards.q: Under the merger (independent-felony) doctrine, a felony that is {{c::an integral part of the homicide itself}}, such as assault with a deadly weapon, cannot serve as the predicate for felony murder (People v. Ireland).
cards.qZh: 根据吸收（独立重罪）原则，____的重罪（如持致命武器攻击）不能作为重罪谋杀的基础罪（People v. Ireland案）。
cards.a: an integral part of the homicide itself
cards.aZh: 本身即为杀人行为组成部分
cards.explainZh: 若允许攻击罪作基础罪，一切故意伤害致死都会自动升格为谋杀，恶意要件将被架空——这就是吸收原则的逻辑。基础重罪必须有独立于伤害目的的重罪目的（如抢劫、纵火）。

cards.q: Fleeing a completed liquor-store robbery with the loot, Rob runs a red light two blocks away and fatally strikes a pedestrian, before reaching any place of safety. Felony murder?
cards.qZh: 罗布抢劫酒品店得手后逃离，两个街区外闯红灯撞死行人，当时尚未到达任何安全处所。是否构成重罪谋杀？
choices: No: the robbery ended when he left the store.
No: the death was accidental.
Yes: the killing occurred during immediate flight, before reaching temporary safety.
Yes, but only if he intended to kill the pedestrian.
cards.explain: Felony murder covers deaths caused during the commission of the felony or immediate flight; the felony terminates only on reaching a place of temporary safety. No intent to kill is required — the death need only be a foreseeable result of the dangerous felony.
cards.explainZh: 重罪谋杀的时间范围＝实施中＋紧接逃离阶段，直到抵达临时安全处所才结束。「离店即终结」一项错在抢劫未随离店而终结；「死亡纯属意外」与「须有杀人故意」两项错在重罪谋杀无需杀人故意，可预见性即可。加州注意：罗布是直接致死者(actual killer)，SB 1437后仍可定罪。
cards.caNote: Post-SB 1437, California first-degree felony murder still reaches the actual killer during an enumerated felony (robbery qualifies); the statute narrowed liability mainly for non-killer accomplices.
cards.caNoteZh: SB 1437后，加州一级重罪谋杀仍适用于列举重罪（含抢劫）中的直接致死者；该法主要收窄的是非杀人共犯的责任。

cards.q: During an armed robbery by Al and Bo, a police officer justifiably shoots and kills Bo. In an agency-theory (majority) jurisdiction, is Al guilty of felony murder for Bo's death?
cards.qZh: 艾尔与博持械抢劫期间，警察合法开枪击毙博。在采代理理论（多数）的法域，艾尔是否对博的死亡构成重罪谋杀？
choices: No: the shot was fired by a police officer, not a felon, and the deceased was a co-felon (Redline).
Yes: any death occurring during the felony qualifies.
Yes: the proximate-cause theory makes this result automatic in every state.
No: robbery is not an inherently dangerous felony.
cards.explain: Agency theory limits felony murder to killings committed by a felon or his agent; Redline additionally bars liability where the decedent is a co-felon justifiably killed. Minority proximate-cause states can reach deaths caused by police resistance, but that is not the majority rule.
cards.explainZh: 两大限制同时命中：(1)代理理论——致死行为须出自重罪犯一方；(2)Redline规则——共犯被合法击毙不算。「重罪期间任何死亡都算」一项是少数'近因理论'的过度延伸；「抢劫非固有危险重罪」一项错在抢劫是典型的固有危险重罪。答题先认定法域采哪种理论。

cards.q: California SB 1437: when is a non-killer now liable for felony murder?
cards.qZh: 加州SB 1437法案：非直接致死者何时仍构成重罪谋杀？
cards.a: Only if the defendant (1) was the actual killer; (2) with intent to kill, aided or abetted the actual killer; or (3) was a major participant in the underlying felony and acted with reckless indifference to human life (Banks/Clark factors). Natural-and-probable-consequences murder liability is abolished, and §1172.6 provides retroactive resentencing for old convictions.
cards.aZh: 仅当被告(1)是直接致死者；(2)以杀人故意帮助或教唆直接致死者；或(3)是基础重罪的主要参与者且对人命漠然置之（Banks/Clark因素）。'自然可能后果'谋杀责任已废除，且第1172.6条允许对旧判决追溯改判。
cards.explainZh: 这是加州论文题最爱：望风司机不再自动构成重罪谋杀，须证明主要参与＋漠视人命（如明知同伙携枪、目睹危险不施救）。把'旧普通法规则→SB 1437新规'的对比写出来就是高分点。
cards.caNote: Exception: felony-murder liability applies regardless of these limits when the victim is a peace officer killed in the line of duty (Pen. Code §189(f)).
cards.caNoteZh: 例外：被害人是执行职务的警察时，不受上述限制，参与者仍可构成重罪谋杀（《刑法典》第189(f)条）。

cards.q: Voluntary manslaughter: the elements of adequate provocation.
cards.qZh: 自愿非预谋杀人（激情杀人）：'充分激愤'的构成要件。
cards.a: (1) Provocation that would arouse sudden and intense passion in an ordinary person (serious battery, threatened deadly attack, discovering a spouse in adultery); (2) the defendant was in fact provoked; (3) insufficient time for an ordinary person to cool off; and (4) the defendant did not in fact cool off. The killing is then mitigated from murder to voluntary manslaughter.
cards.aZh: (1)足以使普通人骤然产生强烈激情的激愤事由（严重殴打、致命攻击威胁、撞见配偶通奸）；(2)被告确实被激怒；(3)普通人来不及冷静的时间间隔；(4)被告实际上也未冷静下来。杀人由谋杀减轻为自愿非预谋杀人。
cards.explainZh: 两客观（普通人会激怒、来不及冷静）+两主观（确实激怒、确实没冷静），四项缺一不可。对比中国故意杀人'情节较轻'量刑思路：美国是罪名降格，中国是幅度调整。
cards.mnemonic: Provocation: 2 objective + 2 subjective

cards.q: In California, a defendant who kills in an honest but {{c::unreasonable}} belief in the need for deadly self-defense lacks malice and is guilty only of voluntary manslaughter (imperfect self-defense).
cards.qZh: 在加州，出于真诚但____的自卫必要性信念而杀人的被告缺乏恶意，仅构成自愿非预谋杀人（不完全正当防卫）。
cards.a: unreasonable
cards.aZh: 不合理
cards.explainZh: 信念真诚→无恶意→非谋杀；信念不合理→非正当防卫→仍有罪。两头都不沾即落入中间档。类比中国防卫过当'应当减轻或免除处罚'，但美国是固定降为一档罪名。
cards.caNote: Unavailable where the defendant's own wrongful conduct (e.g., initiating a deadly assault) created the circumstances requiring force (In re Christian S.).
cards.caNoteZh: 若被告自己的不法行为（如率先发动致命攻击）制造了须用武力的局面，则不得援用此原则（In re Christian S.案）。

cards.q: Involuntary manslaughter: the two routes.
cards.qZh: 非自愿非预谋杀人（过失杀人）：两种构成路径。
cards.a: (1) Criminal-negligence manslaughter: a gross deviation from reasonable care creating a high risk of death or serious injury (MPC grades conscious-risk killings as reckless manslaughter and inadvertent ones as negligent homicide). (2) Misdemeanor-manslaughter (unlawful-act) rule: a death caused during a malum in se misdemeanor, or during a felony insufficient for felony murder.
cards.aZh: (1)刑事过失型：严重偏离合理注意标准，制造死亡或重伤的高度风险（MPC将有意识冒险归为轻率型非预谋杀人，无意识的归为过失致死罪）。(2)轻罪杀人（不法行为）规则：在自体恶轻罪过程中，或在不足以构成重罪谋杀的重罪过程中致人死亡。
cards.explainZh: 刑事过失>民事过失：须重大偏离+高风险。轻罪杀人是重罪谋杀的'缩小版'，同受可预见性限制。中国《刑法》第233条过失致人死亡罪对应第一种路径。

cards.q: After a prior DUI conviction and court-ordered alcohol-education classes warning of the lethal risks, Dee drives at high speed with a 0.18 BAC and kills a pedestrian. In California, prosecutors may properly charge:
cards.qZh: 迪曾因酒驾被定罪并接受法院指令的酒精教育课程（警示致死风险），后以0.18血液酒精浓度高速驾驶撞死行人。在加州，检方可以起诉：
choices: Involuntary manslaughter only.
Gross vehicular manslaughter only.
First-degree premeditated murder.
Second-degree murder on an implied-malice (Watson) theory.
cards.explain: People v. Watson permits second-degree murder for DUI killings where the driver subjectively knew the danger to life and consciously disregarded it; a prior DUI and mandated education supply that awareness. Lesser vehicular offenses remain available, so the 'only' options are wrong; nothing shows premeditation.
cards.explainZh: Watson谋杀=酒驾+主观明知危险+有意漠视→隐含恶意二级谋杀；前科和教育课程正是'明知'的证据（加州DUI判决书还附Watson警告）。「仅过失杀人」与「仅车辆过失杀人」两项错在'只能'——检方可择重起诉；「一级预谋谋杀」一项错在无预谋证据。
cards.caNote: California DUI sentencing includes a formal Watson advisement so that any later DUI fatality can be charged as implied-malice murder.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州酒驾判决包含正式的Watson警告，使日后再犯致死可直接以隐含恶意谋杀起诉。

cards.q: At common law, {{c::words alone}} — however insulting — are not adequate provocation to reduce murder to voluntary manslaughter, though informational words revealing a provoking fact may qualify in some modern courts.
cards.qZh: 依普通法，无论多么侮辱性的____都不构成将谋杀降为激情杀人的充分激愤，但传递激愤事实的告知性言语在部分现代法院可以例外。
cards.a: words alone
cards.aZh: 单纯言语
cards.explainZh: 骂人话再难听也不减罪；但'我刚杀了你孩子'这类告知性言语传递的是激愤事实本身，部分州承认。区分侮辱性言语vs告知性言语是MBE细节考点。

cards.q: Homicide causation: actual cause, proximate cause, intervening acts, and the year-and-a-day rule.
cards.qZh: 杀人罪因果关系：事实原因、法律原因、介入行为及'一年零一天'规则。
cards.a: Actual cause: but-for causation, substantial factor (multiple sufficient causes), or acceleration of death. Proximate cause: death within the foreseeable risk created. Negligent medical treatment, victim frailty (thin-skull rule), and refusal of treatment do not break the chain; grossly negligent or intentional intervening acts do. The year-and-a-day rule has been abolished nearly everywhere.
cards.aZh: 事实原因：若无则不（but-for）、实质因素（多个充分原因并存）或加速死亡。法律（近）原因：死亡在行为制造的可预见风险范围内。医疗过失、被害人特殊体质（蛋壳脑袋规则）、拒绝治疗均不中断因果链；重大过失或故意的介入行为则中断。'一年零一天'规则几乎已被普遍废除。
cards.explainZh: 介入医疗过失可预见→不断链；医生故意杀人→断链。与中国因果关系理论（介入因素异常性判断）思路一致。蛋壳脑袋规则：被害人是血友病人也照样归责。
cards.caNote: California Pen. Code §194: death more than three years and a day after the act creates a rebuttable presumption that the killing was not criminal — prosecution must overcome it.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《刑法典》第194条：行为后超过三年零一天死亡的，可反驳地推定杀害非犯罪所致——检方须推翻该推定。

cards.q: Standing behind Vic, Dan swings a bat at Vic's head and misses; Vic never notices the swing. Dan's liability for assault?
cards.qZh: 丹站在维克身后挥棒击其头部但未击中，维克全程毫无察觉。丹是否构成攻击罪？
choices: None: Vic felt no apprehension.
Guilty of attempted-battery assault; the victim's unawareness is irrelevant.
Guilty only if the bat actually touched Vic.
Guilty of battery.
cards.explain: Assault has two theories: (1) attempted battery — specific intent to injure plus a substantial step, where victim awareness is irrelevant; and (2) intentional creation of reasonable apprehension of imminent battery, which does require awareness. The 'no apprehension' choice applies only the second theory; the 'guilty of battery' choice fails for lack of contact.
cards.explainZh: 攻击罪双轨：未遂殴击型（特定故意+实质步骤，被害人无需察觉）与制造恐惧型（须被害人察觉到临近侵害）。本题走第一轨。「未感恐惧即无罪」一项错用第二轨要件；「殴击罪」一项错在殴击罪(battery)需要身体接触或伤害。
cards.mnemonic: Assault = attempted battery OR apprehension

cards.q: Kidnapping: elements and the asportation requirement.
cards.qZh: 绑架罪：构成要件与移动（劫持转移）要求。
cards.a: Unlawful confinement of a person against his will, coupled with either movement (asportation) of the victim or concealment in a secret place. At common law any movement suffices, but movement merely incidental to another offense (e.g., shoving a robbery victim to the register) does not count.
cards.aZh: 违背他人意愿非法拘束其人身，并伴有转移被害人（劫持移动）或将其藏匿于秘密处所。普通法上任何移动均可，但仅附随于其他犯罪的移动（如抢劫时把被害人推到收银台）不算。
cards.explainZh: 移动要件防止一切抢劫、强奸自动'升格'为绑架。对比中国《刑法》第239条绑架罪以勒索或作人质为目的——美国普通法绑架不要求特定目的，勒索型是加重档。
cards.caNote: California aggravated kidnapping requires movement that is substantial and increases the risk of harm beyond that inherent in the underlying offense (People v. Martinez/Daniels).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州加重绑架要求移动幅度实质且使危险超出基础犯罪固有风险（People v. Martinez/Daniels案）。

cards.q: Rape: modern elements, and what negates consent.
cards.qZh: 强奸罪：现代构成要件及何种情形否定同意。
cards.a: Modern statutes: sexual intercourse without effective consent — gender-neutral, no marital exemption, no resistance requirement, no force needed beyond penetration without consent. Consent is ineffective if obtained by force or threats, from one incapable of consenting (intoxication, unconsciousness, minority), or by fraud in the factum (the act itself); fraud in the inducement does not negate consent.
cards.aZh: 现代制定法：未经有效同意的性交——性别中立、废除婚内豁免、不要求反抗，且除'未经同意的插入'外不要求额外暴力。以下情形同意无效：暴力或威胁取得；对方无同意能力（醉酒、昏迷、未成年）；对行为本身的欺诈（fraud in the factum）。但对动机的诱因欺诈不否定同意。
cards.explainZh: 欺诈两分法是考点：谎称'这是医疗程序'→对行为本身欺诈→构成强奸；谎称'我会娶你'→诱因欺诈→不构成。中国司法解释对'醉酒不能反抗'认定一致。
cards.caNote: California: if consent is withdrawn mid-intercourse and communicated, continuing by force is rape (In re John Z.).
cards.caNoteZh: 加州：性交中撤回同意并明确表达后，强行继续即构成强奸（In re John Z.案）。

cards.q: Larceny requires a trespassory taking and carrying away of another's personal property with intent to permanently deprive existing {{c::at the time of the taking}}; under the continuing-trespass doctrine, a wrongful initial taking 'continues' until the intent to steal is later formed.
cards.qZh: 盗窃罪要求非法取得并移动他人动产，且永久剥夺的故意须存在于____；根据持续侵夺原则，不法的最初取得'持续'至日后形成盗窃故意之时。
cards.a: at the time of the taking
cards.aZh: 取得财物之时
cards.explainZh: 借用时无据为己有之意、日后才起意→原则上非盗窃；但若最初取得本身不法（如未经允许'借'车），侵夺持续，后起盗意仍构成盗窃。任何微小移动即满足'搬离'。

cards.q: Embezzlement vs. larceny: where is the line?
cards.qZh: 侵占罪与盗窃罪：界线何在？
cards.a: Embezzlement is the fraudulent conversion of another's property by one already in lawful possession (trustee, agent, bailee entrusted with more than bare custody). Larceny requires taking from another's possession — an employee with mere custody who takes goods commits larceny. Intent to restore the very property taken may negate embezzlement; a bona fide claim of right negates both.
cards.aZh: 侵占罪是已合法占有他人财产者（受托人、代理人、受寄托人）实施的欺诈性据为己有。盗窃罪须从他人占有中取得——仅有'保管'而非占有的雇员取财构成盗窃。有归还原物的意图可否定侵占；善意的权利主张可同时否定两罪。
cards.explainZh: 考点在'占有'与'保管'之分：低级雇员经手财物只是保管，取财=盗窃；受托管理资金的经理挪用=侵占。对应中国《刑法》第270、271条侵占罪/职务侵占罪，'合法持有后非法占有'思路一致。

cards.q: Con falsely tells Vic he will repair Vic's watch, intending all along to keep it. Vic hands over the watch 'for repair,' and Con sells it. Con committed:
cards.qZh: 康谎称愿为维克修表，实则一开始就打算据为己有。维克交表'送修'，康随即变卖。康构成何罪？
choices: Larceny by trick: the fraud obtained only possession, not title.
False pretenses: Vic parted with the watch voluntarily.
Embezzlement: Con was in lawful possession when he sold it.
No property crime.
cards.explain: What the fraud obtains controls: possession only = larceny by trick; title = false pretenses. Vic expected the same watch back, so only possession passed, and possession procured by fraud is not 'lawful possession' for embezzlement.
cards.explainZh: 看骗到的是什么：只骗到占有→诈骗型盗窃；骗到所有权（如付款、转让）→诈骗取财罪(false pretenses)。「诈骗取财罪」一项错在维克并未转让所有权；「侵占罪」一项错在以欺诈取得的占有不是侵占所需的'合法占有'。中国法均入诈骗罪，美国法细分是考试重点。
cards.mnemonic: Title = false pretenses; possession = larceny by trick

cards.q: Robbery is larceny {{c::from the victim's person or presence, accomplished by force or intimidation}}; an unnoticed pickpocketing is mere larceny, and the threatened harm must be imminent, not future.
cards.qZh: 抢劫罪是____的盗窃；未被察觉的扒窃只是普通盗窃，且威胁的伤害必须是迫在眉睫而非将来的。
cards.a: from the victim's person or presence, accomplished by force or intimidation
cards.aZh: 以暴力或恐吓从被害人身上或面前实施
cards.explainZh: 对比敲诈勒索(extortion)：以将来伤害或揭发相威胁取财，无需当面从人身取得。加州Estes规则：得手后为保住赃物或脱逃而用暴力，仍升格为抢劫——与中国《刑法》第269条转化型抢劫惊人相似。

cards.q: Burglary: common law elements vs. California Penal Code §459.
cards.qZh: 入室罪：普通法要件与加州《刑法典》第459条的对比。
cards.a: Common law: breaking and entering the dwelling of another at night, with intent to commit a felony inside. California §459: any entry — even lawful, during business hours — into any building or listed structure (stores; locked cars), at any time, with intent to commit larceny (grand or petit) or any felony held at entry.
cards.aZh: 普通法：夜间破坏并进入他人住宅，且入内时具有实施重罪的意图。加州第459条：任何进入——无需破坏，甚至可以是营业时间的合法进入——进入任何建筑物或列举构造物（含商店、上锁汽车），不限时间，只要进入时具有实施盗窃（不论数额）或任何重罪的意图。
cards.explainZh: 加州把六项普通法要件砍到只剩'进入+进入时的犯意'。带着行窃意图走进开门营业的商店＝加州入室罪——这是加州论文题最经典的反直觉考点。
cards.caNote: Prop 47 (Pen. Code §459.5): entering an open commercial establishment during business hours intending theft of $950 or less is misdemeanor shoplifting and must be charged as such, not burglary.
cards.caNoteZh: 47号提案（第459.5条）：营业时间进入营业中的商业场所、意图窃取950美元以下财物的，属轻罪商店盗窃，只能按该罪而非入室罪起诉。
cards.mnemonic: CL burglary: Breaking, Entering, Dwelling, Another's, Night, Intent

cards.q: Common law arson requires the malicious burning of the dwelling of another, with actual {{c::charring}} of the structure itself — mere blackening by smoke or scorching is insufficient; modern statutes reach any structure and damage by explosion.
cards.qZh: 普通法纵火罪要求恶意焚烧他人住宅，且建筑结构本身必须实际____——仅有烟熏发黑或表面灼烧不够；现代制定法扩及任何建筑物及爆炸损坏。
cards.a: charring
cards.aZh: 炭化（烧焦）
cards.explainZh: 损害程度阶梯：烟熏(blackening)<灼烧(scorching)<炭化(charring)——只有炭化及以上才既遂。'恶意'不要求纵火动机，轻率制造明显焚烧风险即可。烧自己房屋骗保险在普通法不构成纵火（须'他人'住宅），现代法已改。
cards.mnemonic: Smoke/scorch = no; char = arson

cards.q: State the elements of receiving stolen property and of forgery.
cards.qZh: 收受赃物罪与伪造罪的构成要件。
cards.a: Receiving: taking possession or control of stolen property, knowing it is stolen, intending to permanently deprive the owner. Goods recovered by police lose their stolen character — only attempt remains. Forgery: making or materially altering a writing of apparent legal significance so it is false, with intent to defraud; uttering is presenting such an instrument as genuine.
cards.aZh: 收受赃物罪：明知是赃物而取得其占有或控制，并有永久剥夺物主的意图。若警方已起获该财物，其'赃物'属性消灭——只能构成未遂。伪造罪：制作或实质性变造具有表面法律意义的文书使之虚假，并有诈骗意图；行使伪造文书罪是将该文书当真出示。
cards.explainZh: 经典陷阱：警察截获赃物后'控制交付'，买家只构成收赃未遂。伪造须文书'本身虚假'（假签名），内容撒谎的真文书不算。对应中国《刑法》第312条掩饰隐瞒犯罪所得罪、第280条伪造文书类犯罪。

cards.q: The four insanity tests, and California's rule.
cards.qZh: 四种精神失常检验标准及加州采用的规则。
cards.a: M'Naghten: mental disease prevented knowing the nature and quality of the act, or that it was wrong. Irresistible impulse: unable to control conduct or conform to law. Durham: the crime was the product of mental disease. MPC: lacked substantial capacity to appreciate criminality or conform conduct to law. California follows M'Naghten; the defendant proves insanity by a preponderance.
cards.aZh: 麦克诺顿规则：因精神疾病不能认识行为的性质，或不能认识其为错误。不可抗拒冲动：无法控制自己的行为或使之守法。达勒姆规则：犯罪系精神疾病的产物。MPC：缺乏实质能力去认识行为的犯罪性或使行为守法。加州采麦克诺顿规则；被告须以优势证据证明精神失常。
cards.explainZh: MPC是'认知＋意志'的宽松版；麦克诺顿只看认知。对比中国《刑法》第18条'不能辨认或者不能控制'——竟同时涵盖认知与意志，接近MPC而宽于加州。举证责任在被告是与中国的重大程序差异。
cards.mnemonic: M'Naghten = know Nature or kNow wrong

cards.q: Insanity vs. incompetency to stand trial.
cards.qZh: 犯罪时精神失常与受审能力欠缺的区别。
cards.a: Insanity concerns the defendant's mental state at the time of the offense and is an affirmative defense producing acquittal (NGI). Incompetency concerns the time of trial: whether the defendant can understand the nature of the proceedings and assist counsel (Dusky). It suspends the trial until competence is restored — trying an incompetent defendant violates due process.
cards.aZh: 精神失常针对犯罪时的精神状态，是导致无罪判决（NGI）的积极抗辩。受审能力针对审判之时：被告能否理解程序性质并协助律师（Dusky标准）。能力欠缺使审判中止直至恢复——审判无受审能力的被告违反正当程序。
cards.explainZh: 一个管'当时'（实体出罪），一个管'现在'（程序暂停），互不影响：审判时清醒仍可主张案发时失常，反之亦然。中国法有强制医疗程序但无系统的'受审能力中止'制度，此为差异点。

cards.q: Charged with first-degree premeditated murder, Deb offers evidence she was so intoxicated she could not premeditate or deliberate. The evidence is:
cards.qZh: 黛比被控一级预谋谋杀，提出证据证明她醉酒程度之深已无法预谋和深思。该证据：
choices: Inadmissible: voluntary intoxication is never a defense.
Admissible to negate all homicide liability.
Admissible to negate premeditation and deliberation, reducing the crime to second-degree murder.
Admissible only if the intoxication was involuntary.
cards.explain: Voluntary intoxication may negate specific-intent elements such as premeditation, deliberation, and express-malice intent to kill — but never general intent, recklessness, or implied malice. So the murder drops to second degree rather than disappearing.
cards.explainZh: 自愿醉酒只打特定故意元素：能否定预谋→降为二级谋杀，但打不掉隐含恶意→不能出罪。「醉酒从不构成抗辩」一项太绝对；「否定全部杀人责任」一项走过头；「仅非自愿醉酒可采」一项混淆了非自愿醉酒（按精神失常处理，可全面出罪）。
cards.caNote: Pen. Code §29.4: in California, voluntary intoxication is admissible only on premeditation, deliberation, or express-malice intent to kill — never to negate implied malice.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州《刑法典》第29.4条：自愿醉酒证据仅可用于争议预谋、深思或明示恶意的杀人故意——绝不能用于否定隐含恶意。

cards.q: Involuntary intoxication, infancy, and consent as defenses.
cards.qZh: 非自愿醉酒、未成年与被害人同意作为辩护事由。
cards.a: Involuntary intoxication (taken unknowingly, under duress, or with unexpected effects of prescribed medicine) is treated like insanity and can excuse any crime. Infancy at common law: under 7, no capacity; 7–14, rebuttable presumption of incapacity; 14+, adult capacity. Consent is a defense only where it negates an element (rape) or for minor bodily contacts and lawful sports.
cards.aZh: 非自愿醉酒——不知情摄入、被迫摄入或处方药意外反应——按精神失常处理，符合当地失常标准即可对任何犯罪免责。普通法未成年：不满7岁无刑事能力；7至14岁可反驳地推定无能力；14岁以上视同成人。被害人同意仅在否定构成要件（如强奸）或轻微身体接触、合法体育对抗时才是辩护理由。
cards.explainZh: 同意永远不能正当化重伤——'约架'双方均构成殴击罪。中国刑责年龄现为12/14/16三档（刑法修正案十一），与普通法7/14线对照记忆。

cards.q: Deadly force in self-defense: requirements, retreat, and the initial aggressor's position.
cards.qZh: 自卫中使用致命武力：要件、退避义务与先动手者的地位。
cards.a: A non-aggressor may use deadly force on reasonable belief of imminent death or great bodily harm from unlawful force; force must be proportional. Majority and California: no duty to retreat. An initial aggressor regains self-defense only by (1) complete withdrawal communicated to the adversary, or (2) the victim's sudden escalation of a non-deadly fight to deadly force.
cards.aZh: 非挑起争斗者在合理相信即将遭受威胁生命或重大身体伤害的不法武力时，可使用致命武力；武力须相称。多数规则及加州：无退避义务。先动手者仅在以下情形恢复自卫权：(1)彻底退出争斗并明确告知对方；(2)对方将非致命冲突骤然升级为致命武力。
cards.explainZh: 三关键词：合理相信、迫在眉睫、相称。中国《刑法》第20条第3款对行凶、杀人等暴力犯罪设'特殊防卫'（无防卫过当）——比美国规则更宽，考试务必用美国标准作答。

cards.q: Duress excuses a crime committed under a threat of imminent death or serious bodily harm to the defendant or a family member, but at common law it is never a defense to {{c::intentional murder}}.
cards.qZh: 胁迫可为在'对本人或家人施加迫在眉睫的死亡或重伤威胁'之下实施的犯罪免责，但依普通法，胁迫绝不能作为____的抗辩。
cards.a: intentional murder
cards.aZh: 故意杀人（谋杀）
cards.explainZh: '杀我还是杀他'——法律要求宁死不杀人。但间接路径要留意：胁迫可作基础重罪（如抢劫）的抗辩，从而间接击破重罪谋杀。对比中国《刑法》第28条胁从犯'应当减轻或免除'——中国无谋杀除外规则。

cards.q: Necessity: elements and limits, and how it differs from duress.
cards.qZh: 紧急避险：要件、限制及与胁迫的区别。
cards.a: Necessity justifies conduct compelled by natural or physical forces as the lesser evil: reasonable belief the act was necessary to avoid a greater, imminent harm; no adequate legal alternative; the harm avoided outweighs the harm caused; and the defendant did not create the peril. It is not a defense to intentional homicide (Dudley & Stephens). Duress arises from human threats; necessity from circumstances.
cards.aZh: 紧急避险将迫于自然或客观力量、两害相权取其轻的行为正当化：合理相信行为为避免更大且迫近的损害所必需；无适当合法替代手段；避免的损害大于造成的损害；且危险非被告自己制造。不能作为故意杀人的抗辩（Dudley & Stephens案）。胁迫源于他人威胁，紧急避险源于客观情势。
cards.explainZh: 与中国《刑法》第21条紧急避险高度相似（职务上有特定责任者不适用避险的规定中国独有）。记忆：胁迫=人逼的（excuse宽恕），避险=天逼的（justification正当化）。

cards.q: Force in defense of habitation and property, and to prevent crime or effect arrest.
cards.qZh: 保卫住宅与财产、制止犯罪及实施逮捕时的武力界限。
cards.a: Habitation: deadly force may prevent a violent entry or one intended for a felony inside. Property alone: reasonable non-deadly force only — never deadly force or mechanical deadly devices (spring guns). Crime prevention: non-deadly force; deadly only to stop a dangerous felony threatening life. Arrest: deadly force only against a fleeing felon posing danger to others (Garner).
cards.aZh: 保卫住宅：可用致命武力阻止暴力闯入或意图入内犯重罪的闯入。仅保卫财产：只能用合理的非致命武力——绝不可用致命武力，也不得设置致命机械装置（弹簧枪）。制止犯罪：非致命武力；仅对危及人命的危险重罪可用致命武力。逮捕：警察仅可对危及他人的逃跑重罪犯使用致命武力（Tennessee v. Garner案）。
cards.explainZh: 层级记忆：人命>住宅>财产。财产永远不值一条命——弹簧枪案(Katko)是经典。Garner案将逮捕武力并入第四修正案'合理性'审查，也是宪法题考点。

cards.q: Under the majority (subjective) test, entrapment requires {{c::government inducement of the crime plus the defendant's lack of predisposition}} to commit it; merely providing an opportunity to a willing criminal is not inducement.
cards.qZh: 依多数（主观）标准，警察圈套抗辩要求____；仅向本有犯意者提供犯罪机会不构成引诱。
cards.a: government inducement of the crime plus the defendant's lack of predisposition
cards.aZh: 政府引诱犯罪且被告本无犯罪倾向
cards.explainZh: 卧底卖毒品给惯犯≠圈套（有倾向）；反复纠缠、利诱守法者才是。私人引诱永远不构成圈套。少数/MPC采客观标准只看警方手段。中国无对应抗辩，但'犯意引诱'在毒品案件量刑中有类似考量。

cards.q: Al shoves Bo in a bar dispute. Bo draws a knife and lunges to stab Al, who cannot escape and shoots Bo dead. Al's best defense?
cards.qZh: 酒吧争执中艾尔推搡了博。博拔刀扑刺，艾尔无路可逃，开枪将博击毙。艾尔最有力的抗辩是？
choices: None: the initial aggressor never regains the right of self-defense.
Defense of others.
Necessity.
Self-defense: Bo's escalation to deadly force revived Al's right.
cards.explain: A non-deadly initial aggressor regains the right of self-defense when the victim suddenly escalates the fight to deadly force. The 'aggressor never regains the right' choice states the aggressor rule too absolutely; the other doctrines simply do not fit.
cards.explainZh: 推搡=非致命挑衅；对方拔刀=致命升级→先动手者自卫权复活，可用致命武力还击。「先动手者永不恢复自卫权」一项把先动手者规则绝对化（另一恢复途径是撤退并告知）；「防卫他人」与「紧急避险」两项与事实无关。

cards.q: Fourth Amendment threshold: government action, and who has standing to challenge a search.
cards.qZh: 第四修正案门槛：政府行为要件，以及谁有资格挑战搜查。
cards.a: The Amendment restrains only government actors and their agents, and suppression requires that the defendant's own reasonable expectation of privacy was invaded. Standing: homeowners and residents; overnight guests (Olson); authorized-in-fact rental drivers (Byrd). No standing: short-term commercial visitors (Carter); passengers challenging a search of another's car (Rakas) — though a stop seizes passengers, who may challenge the stop itself (Brendlin).
cards.aZh: 第四修正案只约束政府行为者及其代理人，且排除证据要求被告本人的合理隐私期待受侵犯。有资格：房主与居住者；过夜客人（Olson案）；实际获授权的租车驾驶人（Byrd案）。无资格：短暂到访的商业访客（Carter案）；就搜查他人汽车而言的乘客（Rakas案）——但拦停构成对乘客的扣押，乘客可挑战拦停本身（Brendlin案）。
cards.explainZh: 先问'政府行为？'再问'谁的隐私？'——朋友车里搜出你的毒品，你通常无权排除（打击'保管人辩护'）。中国非法证据排除不设'排除资格'限制，此为中美结构性差异。

cards.q: What counts as a Fourth Amendment 'search'?
cards.qZh: 什么行为构成第四修正案意义上的'搜查'？
cards.a: Invading a reasonable expectation of privacy (Katz) or physically trespassing on persons, houses, papers, or effects to gather information (Jones). Searches: GPS trackers (Jones); 7+ days of historical cell-site location data despite the third-party doctrine (Carpenter); geofence acquisition of cell-phone location data (Chatrie, 2026); a drug dog on the porch — curtilage (Jardines); home thermal imaging (Kyllo). Not searches: open fields, overflights, curbside garbage, public dog sniffs (Place/Caballes).
cards.aZh: 侵入合理隐私期待（Katz案），或为获取信息而对人身、住宅、文件、财物实施物理侵入（Jones案）。属于搜查：安装GPS追踪器（Jones）；调取7天以上历史手机基站位置信息——第三方原则不适用（Carpenter）；'地理围栏'反查手机位置数据（Chatrie，2026）；缉毒犬进入门廊——宅院附属区域（Jardines）；对住宅热成像（Kyllo）。不属于搜查：开阔地、空中俯瞰、路边垃圾、公共场所犬嗅（Place/Caballes）。
cards.explainZh: 两条独立路径：隐私期待(Katz) + 物理侵入(Jones复活)。Carpenter是数字时代转折：银行记录、拨号记录仍适用第三方原则，但CSLI例外。门廊犬嗅=搜查、机场行李犬嗅=非搜查，位置决定结论。Chatrie（2026）把Carpenter延伸到geofence（按地理范围反查在场手机）——同属搜查，原则上需令状。

cards.q: Terry stops and frisks: standards and scope.
cards.qZh: 特里拦停与拍身检查：标准与范围。
cards.a: Stop: reasonable suspicion of crime from specific articulable facts — unprovoked flight in a high-crime area qualifies (Wardlow); a bare anonymous tip does not (J.L.), though a corroborated 911 call may (Navarette). Frisk: separate reasonable suspicion the person is armed and dangerous; pat-down for weapons only. Plain feel: contraband immediately apparent to the touch may be seized (Dickerson).
cards.aZh: 拦停：基于具体可说明事实的合理怀疑——高犯罪率地区无故逃跑即可（Wardlow案）；单纯匿名举报不行（J.L.案），但细节充分且获印证的911报警可以（Navarette案）。拍身：须另有'持械且危险'的合理怀疑，且仅限于为查找武器而拍摸外衣。'一摸即知'：触感立即表明是违禁品的可以扣押（Dickerson案）。
cards.explainZh: 合理怀疑<合理根据<排除合理怀疑，三级证明标准是框架。拍身只找武器，不是找证据——摸到软包再捏、再揉即超范围。中国《刑诉法》盘查制度类似但无系统的司法审查标准。

cards.q: Traffic stops: ordering occupants out, duration, and pretext.
cards.qZh: 交通拦停：命令乘员下车、时长限制与借口性拦停。
cards.a: A stop requires reasonable suspicion of a violation; the officer's subjective motive is irrelevant if an objective violation exists (Whren). Officers may order out the driver (Mimms) and passengers (Wilson). Absent independent reasonable suspicion, the stop may not be measurably prolonged beyond its mission, even briefly for a dog sniff (Rodriguez); a sniff during a lawful stop is fine (Caballes).
cards.aZh: 拦停须有交通违法的合理怀疑；只要客观上存在违法，警察的主观动机无关紧要（Whren案）。警察可命令驾驶人（Mimms案）和乘客（Wilson案）下车。无独立合理怀疑时，拦停不得为犬嗅等目的而超出其任务所需时间——哪怕短暂延长也不行（Rodriguez案）；在合法拦停期间完成的犬嗅则合法（Caballes案）。
cards.explainZh: Whren='借口拦停合法'：想查毒品但确有压线违章即可拦。Rodriguez='时间即宪法'：任务完成后多留7分钟等警犬=违宪。两案一宽一严，常配对出题。

cards.q: Arrest rules: warrants, homes, and minor offenses.
cards.qZh: 逮捕规则:令状、住宅与轻微违法。
cards.a: All arrests require probable cause. Public arrests need no warrant (Watson), even for minor, fine-only offenses (Atwater). A routine arrest inside the arrestee's own home requires an arrest warrant plus reason to believe he is within (Payton); arresting a suspect inside a third party's home requires a search warrant for that home (Steagald).
cards.aZh: 一切逮捕均须合理根据。公共场所逮捕无需令状（Watson案），即便是仅处罚金的轻微违法（Atwater案）。在被逮捕人自己家中实施常规逮捕，须有逮捕令并有理由相信其在屋内（Payton案）；进入第三人住宅抓人，须对该住宅取得搜查令（Steagald案）。
cards.explainZh: 记忆:街上不用令，进自家门要逮捕令，进别人家要搜查令。中国逮捕须检察院批准或法院决定——审批主体不同，美国由中立法官签发且街头逮捕根本无需令状。

cards.q: Search warrant requirements, Franks challenges, and knock-and-announce.
cards.qZh: 搜查令的要件、Franks质疑与敲门告知规则。
cards.a: Requirements: (1) probable cause under the totality of the circumstances (Gates — informant tips weighed holistically); (2) particularity as to place and items; (3) a neutral and detached magistrate. Franks: suppression if the defendant proves the affidavit contained a knowing or reckless false statement necessary to probable cause. Knock-and-announce violations do not trigger exclusion (Hudson).
cards.aZh: 有效搜查令要求：(1)依情况总和判断的合理根据（Gates案——线人举报综合衡量）；(2)对搜查地点与扣押物品的特定性描述；(3)由中立超然的治安法官签发。Franks案：被告证明宣誓书中存在明知或轻率的虚假陈述且该陈述为认定合理根据所必需的，证据应予排除。违反敲门告知规则不导致证据排除（Hudson案）。
cards.explainZh: Gates废除了旧的双叉标准，改为总体判断。Hudson是排除规则收缩的信号：程序违规但证据照收，靠民事诉讼救济。中国搜查证由侦查机关自行审批——'中立法官'审查是美国制度核心差异。

cards.q: Officers arrest Dan for driving on a suspended license, handcuff him, and lock him in the patrol car. They then search his car's passenger compartment and find cocaine. The search is:
cards.qZh: 警察以吊销驾照期间驾车为由逮捕丹，铐上手铐并锁入警车，随后搜查其汽车乘员舱查获可卡因。该搜查：
choices: Valid as a search incident to a lawful arrest.
Invalid: Dan was secured, and no evidence of the offense of arrest could be found in the car (Gant).
Valid under the automobile exception.
Invalid: any vehicle search always requires a warrant.
cards.explain: Gant confines vehicle searches incident to arrest to two situations: the arrestee is unsecured and within reaching distance, or it is reasonable to believe the vehicle contains evidence of the offense of arrest. A suspended-license offense can yield no such evidence, and no probable cause supported the automobile exception.
cards.explainZh: Gant两支柱：人未被控制且能够到车内，或有理由相信车内有'本次被捕罪名'的证据。吊照驾驶不可能在车里留证据→两支柱皆空。「汽车例外」一项错在无合理根据；「搜车一律需令状」一项太绝对（汽车例外本就无需令状）。
cards.mnemonic: Gant: unsecured & reaching, OR evidence of the offense of arrest

cards.q: Under Riley v. California, police may seize a cell phone incident to arrest, but must generally {{c::obtain a warrant}} before searching its digital contents.
cards.qZh: 根据Riley v. California案，警察可以在逮捕附带搜查中扣押手机，但在搜查其数字内容前原则上必须____。
cards.a: obtain a warrant
cards.aZh: 取得搜查令
cards.explainZh: 手机=装在口袋里的全部隐私，逮捕附带搜查的两个理由（护警、防毁证）都够不着数字数据。可扣机、可检查手机壳有无刀片，但开机翻内容须令状（紧急情形例外仍在）。

cards.q: Under the automobile exception, probable cause to believe a readily mobile vehicle contains evidence permits a warrantless search of {{c::every part of the vehicle and any container that could hold the object sought}} (Ross/Acevedo), including passengers' belongings (Houghton).
cards.qZh: 依汽车例外，有合理根据相信可随时移动的车辆内藏有证据时，可无证搜查____（Ross/Acevedo案），包括乘客的物品（Houghton案）。
cards.a: every part of the vehicle and any container that could hold the object sought
cards.aZh: 车辆的每一部分及任何可能装下目标物品的容器
cards.explainZh: 范围由'找什么'决定：找偷来的电视机不能翻手套箱；找毒品几乎哪儿都能搜。无需额外紧急情况，车辆可移动性本身即是理由；停在车道上的房车也适用（Carney案）。

cards.q: Plain view doctrine: the three requirements.
cards.qZh: '一目了然'原则：三项要件。
cards.a: (1) The officer is lawfully present at the vantage point; (2) the officer has a lawful right of physical access to the item; and (3) the item's incriminating character is immediately apparent — probable cause on sight, without further manipulation. Moving stereo equipment to read serial numbers was itself an unlawful search (Hicks). Plain view justifies seizure; it never justifies the initial entry.
cards.aZh: (1)警察合法处于观察位置；(2)对物品享有合法的实际接触权；(3)物品的罪证性质一目了然——一看即有合理根据，无需进一步翻动。为看序列号而挪动音响本身即构成非法搜查（Hicks案）。一目了然只正当化扣押，绝不正当化最初的进入。
cards.explainZh: 第三要件最易考：'挪一下、翻个面'就毁掉一切(Hicks)。类推'一嗅即知''一摸即知'。合法进入屋内执行逮捕令时看见桌上毒品→可扣；为找毒品先闯入→不可。

cards.q: Consent searches: voluntariness, scope, and co-occupants.
cards.qZh: 同意搜查：自愿性、范围与共同居住人。
cards.a: Consent must be voluntary under the totality; police need not warn of the right to refuse (Schneckloth), but falsely claiming a warrant vitiates consent (Bumper). Scope: what a reasonable person would understand. Any occupant with actual or apparent authority may consent (Matlock/Rodriguez), but a physically present co-tenant's objection controls (Randolph) unless he is lawfully removed (Fernandez).
cards.aZh: 同意须依情况总和判断为自愿；警察无需告知有权拒绝（Schneckloth案），但谎称持有搜查令使同意无效（Bumper案）。范围以合理人对该同意的理解为准。任何有实际或表面权限的居住人均可同意（Matlock/Rodriguez案），但在场共同居住人的反对优先（Randolph案）——除非其被合法带离，此后另一人的同意即足够（Fernandez案）。
cards.explainZh: Randolph极窄：反对者必须'站在门口反对'；被合法逮捕带走后，室友同意照样有效(Fernandez)。表面权限=警察合理相信有权同意即可，事后发现无权也不排除。

cards.q: An officer signals Max to stop for blasting music, a misdemeanor. Max drives into his attached garage; the officer follows inside without a warrant and arrests him. Under Lange v. California, the entry is:
cards.qZh: 警察因马克斯高音量放音乐（轻罪）示意其停车。马克斯驶入自家附属车库，警察未持令状跟入并逮捕。依Lange v. California案，该进入：
choices: Not automatically valid: pursuit of a fleeing misdemeanant requires case-by-case exigency.
Valid: hot pursuit categorically justifies warrantless home entry.
Invalid: hot pursuit can never apply to misdemeanors.
Valid under the automobile exception.
cards.explain: Lange rejected a categorical misdemeanor-pursuit exception: entry requires actual exigency on the facts — imminent harm, escape, or evidence destruction. Felony hot pursuit remains categorically recognized (Santana). The automobile exception governs vehicle searches, not home entries.
cards.explainZh: Lange(2021)：追轻罪逃跑者≠自动紧急情形，须个案证明（危害迫近、逃脱、毁证）。「热追一律可入宅」一项是重罪规则(Santana)；「轻罪绝无热追」一项反向绝对化——个案有紧急仍可进；「汽车例外」一项张冠李戴。追逐重罪嫌犯入宅依然categorically合法，轻重罪分流是新考点。

cards.q: Exigent circumstances beyond hot pursuit: emergency aid, destruction of evidence, and blood draws.
cards.qZh: 追捕之外的紧急情形：紧急救助、证据灭失与抽血检测。
cards.a: Emergency aid: entry on an objectively reasonable basis to believe an occupant is seriously injured or imminently threatened (Brigham City) — probable cause is NOT required; the emergency-aid standard is non-investigative and less demanding (Case v. Montana, 2026, unanimous). Imminent destruction of evidence justifies entry, even when the exigency arose from lawful police knocking (King), so long as police did not create it unconstitutionally. Blood draws: alcohol dissipation is not per se exigency (McNeely); exigency almost always exists for unconscious drivers (Mitchell).
cards.aZh: 紧急救助：有客观合理依据认为屋内有人重伤或面临紧迫伤害威胁即可进入（Brigham City案）——无需达到'合理根据'（probable cause）：该标准属非侦查性质、低于合理根据（Case v. Montana，2026，一致意见）。证据即将灭失可正当化进入，即使该紧急情形因警察合法敲门可预见地产生（King案）——只要警察未以违宪方式制造紧急。抽血：酒精代谢本身不构成当然紧急（McNeely案），但驾驶人昏迷时几乎必然存在紧急情形（Mitchell案）。
cards.explainZh: 三类紧急+一个反制造原则：警察敲门致嫌犯冲马桶→仍算紧急(King)；警察违宪闯入制造的紧急→不算。酒驾抽血两案对照记：清醒需令状(McNeely)、昏迷可直接抽(Mitchell)。Case v. Montana（2026）解决分歧：紧急救助进入不适用probable cause——那是刑事侦查概念，救助只问'客观合理依据'。

cards.q: Special-needs and inventory searches: schools, checkpoints, and impounds; then the exclusionary rule and its exceptions.
cards.qZh: 特殊需要与清点搜查（学校、检查站、扣押车辆），以及排除规则及其例外。
cards.a: Schools: reasonable grounds, no warrant (T.L.O.). Checkpoints: sobriety valid (Sitz); drug interdiction invalid, ordinary crime control (Edmond); information-seeking fine (Lidster). Inventories of impounded cars and arrestees: valid per standardized routine. Exclusionary rule: illegal evidence and its fruits suppressed, except Leon good faith, Herring isolated negligence, independent source (Murray), inevitable discovery (Nix), attenuation via intervening valid arrest warrant (Strieff), and impeachment.
cards.aZh: 学校：合理理由即可，无需令状（T.L.O.案）。检查站：酒驾检查站合法（Sitz案）；缉毒检查站因属一般犯罪控制而违宪（Edmond案）；征集线索的拦停合法（Lidster案）。对扣押车辆与在押人员的清点登记：依标准化程序进行即合法。排除规则：非法取得的证据及其毒树之果应排除，例外——Leon善意信赖（表面有效令状）、Herring孤立过失、独立来源（Murray）、必然发现（Nix）、稀释原则含拦停期间发现有效逮捕令（Strieff）、以及弹劾用途。
cards.explainZh: 检查站合宪性看'首要目的'：交通安全可以，抓毒品不行。排除规则例外口诀：善意、独立、必然、稀释、弹劾。Strieff(2016)是稀释新宠：违法拦停→查出在先逮捕令→搜出毒品→不排除。中国《刑诉法》第56条仅强制排除刑讯言词证据，实物证据裁量排除——美国以吓阻警察为目的的体系宽严相反。
cards.mnemonic: Exceptions: Good faith, Independent source, Inevitable discovery, Attenuation, Impeachment

cards.q: When is Miranda required? Define custody and interrogation.
cards.qZh: 何时必须给予米兰达警告？'羁押'与'讯问'如何界定。
cards.a: Required for custodial interrogation by known government agents. Custody: formal arrest or equivalent restraint on freedom of movement, judged objectively (age relevant, J.D.B.); routine traffic stops are not custody (Berkemer); inmates are not automatically in custody (Howes). Interrogation: express questioning or its functional equivalent — conduct reasonably likely to elicit an incriminating response (Innis). Undercover agents need not warn (Perkins).
cards.aZh: 已知身份的政府人员进行羁押讯问时须先警告。羁押：正式逮捕或与逮捕相当的行动自由限制，客观判断（未成年人年龄是考量因素——J.D.B.案）；常规交通拦停不是羁押（Berkemer案），在监服刑者也不自动构成羁押（Howes案）。讯问：直接发问或其功能等同物——警察可合理预见会诱出归罪回答的言行（Innis案）。卧底无需警告（Perkins案）。
cards.explainZh: 公式：羁押×讯问×已知警察身份，三者齐备才触发。Perkins逻辑：不知对方是警察就无'警察主导氛围'的强制。中国《刑诉法》讯问前告知权利义务、'不得强迫自证其罪'（第52条）形似而神异——中国无讯问时律师在场权。

cards.q: Officers corner a rape suspect in a supermarket wearing an empty shoulder holster. Before any warnings, one asks, 'Where's the gun?' He gestures: 'Over there.' The statement and the recovered gun are:
cards.qZh: 警察在超市围住一名佩戴空枪套的强奸案嫌疑人，未作任何警告即问：'枪在哪？'嫌疑人指示方位。该陈述与起获的枪支：
choices: Both suppressed: custodial interrogation without warnings.
Statement suppressed; the gun admissible as physical fruit.
Both admissible under the public-safety exception (Quarles).
Admissible only to impeach him at trial.
cards.explain: Quarles: questions reasonably prompted by an immediate threat to public safety — a hidden loaded gun in a public place — require no Miranda warnings, so both the statement and the weapon are admissible in the case-in-chief.
cards.explainZh: 公共安全例外：警告可等，藏在货架间的上膛枪不能等。「两者皆排除」一项忽视了例外；「陈述排除、枪可采」一项是Patane规则（普通违反米兰达时实物果实可采）——本题连陈述都可采；「仅可用于弹劾」一项把'仅弹劾'用错了场景。

cards.q: A Miranda invocation of counsel or of silence must be {{c::unambiguous and unequivocal}} — 'maybe I should talk to a lawyer' does not count (Davis), and merely remaining silent through hours of questioning is not an invocation (Berghuis v. Thompkins).
cards.qZh: 援引米兰达律师权或沉默权的表示必须____——'也许我该找个律师'不算数（Davis案），面对长时间讯问单纯保持沉默也不构成援引（Berghuis v. Thompkins案）。
cards.a: unambiguous and unequivocal
cards.aZh: 明确且毫不含糊
cards.explainZh: 讽刺规则：想行使沉默权必须开口说。Berghuis另一半：警告后开口回答=默示放弃，无需签字。放弃须明知＋自愿，举证责任在检方（优势证据）。
cards.mnemonic: Silence ≠ invoking silence; you must SAY it

cards.q: Once a suspect invokes his Miranda right to counsel, police may not reinitiate interrogation on any offense unless counsel is present, the suspect himself reinitiates, or there has been a break in custody of at least {{c::14 days}} (Edwards; Maryland v. Shatzer).
cards.qZh: 嫌疑人一旦援引米兰达律师权，警方不得就任何罪名重启讯问，除非律师在场、嫌疑人主动重启，或已有至少____的脱离羁押间隔（Edwards案；Maryland v. Shatzer案）。
cards.a: 14 days
cards.explainZh: Edwards保护不分罪名（对比第六修正案的罪名特定性）。Shatzer把'永久保护'改为14天冷却期——回归日常生活14天后可再次接触。援引沉默权则适用较宽的Mosley'审慎尊重'标准，可换罪名换时间再问。

cards.q: Consequences of a Miranda violation vs. an involuntary confession.
cards.qZh: 违反米兰达规则与非自愿供述的法律后果对比。
cards.a: Unwarned but voluntary statements: excluded from the case-in-chief, usable to impeach (Harris); physical fruits admissible (Patane); a later warned statement is admissible (Elstad) unless police used a deliberate two-step strategy (Seibert). Involuntary confessions require police coercion; mental illness alone is not enough (Connelly); they violate due process, are inadmissible for all purposes including impeachment, and their fruits are excluded.
cards.aZh: 未警告但自愿的陈述：不得用于案件主证明，但可用于弹劾（Harris案）；实物果实可采（Patane案）；之后经正规警告的陈述可采（Elstad案），除非警方蓄意采用'先问后警告'两步策略（Seibert案）。非自愿供述：必须存在警方强制——嫌疑人自身精神疾病不够（Connelly案）；其违反正当程序，任何用途（包括弹劾）均不可采，果实亦排除。
cards.explainZh: 两个轨道天壤之别：米兰达违规=预防性规则，漏洞多（弹劾、实物、后续陈述）；刑讯逼供=宪法实体违反，一律排除。中国《刑诉法》第56条强制排除的正是后者（刑讯取得的言词证据），与美国'自愿性'轨道对应。

cards.q: Before any arrest, Sam voluntarily answers police questions about a murder but falls silent when asked whether ballistics would match his shotgun, shuffling his feet. At trial the prosecutor cites that silence as guilt evidence. Sam's Fifth Amendment claim fails because:
cards.qZh: 山姆在被捕前自愿接受警方询问，但被问到弹道是否与其猎枪吻合时沉默不语、脚步不安。庭审中检察官将该沉默作为有罪证据。山姆的第五修正案主张不成立，原因是：
choices: Silence is never constitutionally protected.
He did not expressly invoke the privilege in a noncustodial setting (Salinas).
The privilege against self-incrimination applies only at trial.
Shuffling feet is physical, nontestimonial conduct.
cards.explain: Salinas v. Texas: outside custody, the privilege is not self-executing — a suspect must expressly claim it, and mere silence during voluntary questioning may be used against him. Griffin still forbids comment on a defendant's failure to testify at trial.
cards.explainZh: Salinas(2013)：非羁押自愿问答中，沉默要受保护必须明说'我援引第五修正案'。「沉默从不受宪法保护」一项太绝对——Griffin案禁止评论被告不出庭作证；「特权仅限庭审」一项忽视审前场景也可援引；「挪脚属非证言性举动」一项答非所问。羁押+米兰达警告后的沉默则不得用作弹劾(Doyle)。

cards.q: Scope of the Fifth Amendment privilege, and the immunity sufficient to defeat it.
cards.qZh: 第五修正案特权的范围，以及足以压倒该特权的豁免。
cards.a: The privilege protects natural persons against compelled testimonial communications — not physical evidence such as blood samples, handwriting or voice exemplars, or lineup appearances (Schmerber). Producing documents can be protected act-of-production testimony (existence, possession, authenticity). Use-plus-derivative-use immunity is coextensive with the privilege and compels testimony (Kastigar); transactional immunity is broader than the Constitution requires. Comment on a defendant's trial silence is forbidden (Griffin).
cards.aZh: 该特权保护自然人免受强迫作出证言性交流——不保护身体证据，如血样、笔迹或声音样本、列队辨认（Schmerber案）。提交文件行为本身可能构成受保护的'提交行为证言'（承认文件存在、持有、真实性）。'使用及派生使用豁免'与特权范围相同，足以强制作证（Kastigar案）；'交易豁免'超出宪法要求。禁止评论被告在审判中不作证（Griffin案）。
cards.explainZh: 口诀：护嘴不护身——抽血、按指纹、站队都不能拒绝。豁免只需封锁'证言及其线索'，无需赦免整个罪行。公司无此特权。中国'不得强迫自证其罪'（刑诉法52条）无豁免换证言机制，作无罪推定/沉默权对比时好用。

cards.q: Double jeopardy: when it attaches, the Blockburger test, and lesser/greater offenses.
cards.qZh: 禁止双重危险：何时附着、Blockburger标准与轻重罪关系。
cards.a: Attaches when the jury is sworn (bench trial: first witness); civil penalties do not count. Blockburger: offenses are different only if each requires an element the other does not. Lesser and greater included offenses are the same offence: disposition of one bars later prosecution of the other (Brown), unless facts needed for the greater (victim's death) had not yet occurred.
cards.aZh: 陪审团宣誓（陪审审判）或首名证人宣誓（法官审判）时危险附着；民事处罚不算。Blockburger标准：仅当两罪各自均含对方所无的要件时才是不同犯罪。轻罪与其加重罪属'同一犯罪'——就其一定罪或无罪后禁止再诉另一罪（Brown v. Ohio案），除非加重罪所需事实（如被害人死亡）当时尚未发生。
cards.explainZh: 附着点在先：开庭前撤诉可重诉。'各有独有要件'画维恩图判断：抢劫吸收盗窃→同一罪。'事后死亡'例外：伤害罪定罪后被害人死亡，仍可诉杀人。无罪判决绝对终局，检方不得上诉——与中国检察院可抗诉无罪判决形成尖锐对比。

cards.q: A federal jury acquits Gil of a firearms offense. Alabama then prosecutes him under its own statute for the same conduct. Gil's double-jeopardy motion should be:
cards.qZh: 联邦陪审团判吉尔的枪支罪名不成立。阿拉巴马州随后依本州法律就同一行为起诉他。吉尔的双重危险动议应当：
choices: Granted: same conduct, same elements.
Granted: an acquittal bars all future prosecutions anywhere.
Denied unless Alabama presents newly discovered evidence.
Denied: separate sovereigns may each prosecute the same act (Gamble).
cards.explain: Under the dual-sovereignty doctrine (reaffirmed in Gamble, 2019), state and federal governments — and different states — draw authority from separate sources and may each prosecute the same conduct. A state and its own municipalities, however, are one sovereign.
cards.explainZh: 分别主权原则：联邦与州、州与州各自独立追诉不违宪；州与其市镇是同一主权，不得接力起诉。'新证据'与本规则无关。另记：流审（陪审团僵局=必要性所迫）后可重审；被告上诉推翻后可重审，但以证据不足推翻的除外(Burks)。

cards.q: Sixth Amendment right to counsel: attachment, offense-specificity, and Massiah vs. Miranda.
cards.qZh: 第六修正案律师权：何时附着、罪名特定性，以及Massiah与米兰达的区别。
cards.a: Attaches at the first formal charge or initial appearance (Rothgery); offense-specific (McNeil/Cobb). Thereafter police may not deliberately elicit statements on that charge absent counsel or waiver (Massiah), including via informants who stir conversation; passive listening posts are permitted (Kuhlmann). Unlike Miranda: no custody or known officer required. Montejo: waiver during police-initiated questioning is valid even after counsel is appointed.
cards.aZh: 该权利自首次正式指控或初次到庭时附着（Rothgery案），且具罪名特定性（McNeil案；罪名依Blockburger界定——Cobb案）。附着后，警方不得在无律师或无有效放弃时就该罪名蓄意诱取陈述（Massiah案）——包括主动挑起话题的狱内线人；纯被动的'监听哨'则允许（Kuhlmann案）。与米兰达不同：无需羁押、无需表明警察身份。Montejo案：即便已指定律师，被告仍可在警方主动讯问中有效放弃。
cards.explainZh: 对照表：米兰达=羁押+讯问+任何罪名；Massiah=正式指控后+蓄意诱取+仅限该罪名（卧底也触发）。Montejo(2009)推翻Jackson案——指定律师后警察仍可上门尝试取得放弃。关键阶段：讯问、辨认列队、预审、认罪、量刑均含在内。

cards.q: Ineffective assistance of counsel: the Strickland test and its plea-bargain applications.
cards.qZh: 律师无效协助：Strickland标准及其在辩诉交易中的适用。
cards.a: (1) Deficient performance: below an objective standard of reasonableness, with a strong presumption of sound strategy; (2) prejudice: a reasonable probability that, but for the errors, the result would differ. Pleas: counsel must correctly advise on clear deportation consequences (Padilla); bad advice causing rejection or lapse of a favorable offer is prejudicial — remedy: re-offer the bargain (Lafler/Frye).
cards.aZh: (1)履职缺陷：代理水平低于客观合理标准，且法院强烈推定属于合理策略；(2)不利影响：若无该错误，结果有合理可能性不同。辩诉交易场景：律师必须就明确的驱逐出境后果给出正确建议（Padilla案）；因错误建议导致拒绝或错过有利认罪协议的构成不利影响，救济是重新提出原协议（Lafler/Frye案）。
cards.explainZh: 两叉都难：策略推定挡第一叉，'结果概率'挡第二叉。Padilla对移民客户是必考点——'刑事律师须懂移民法'。极端情形（律师完全缺位、利益冲突）依Cronic直接推定不利影响。
cards.mnemonic: Strickland: Deficient + Prejudice

cards.q: Self-representation (Faretta) and counsel of choice.
cards.qZh: 自我辩护（Faretta案）与选任律师权。
cards.a: A defendant who knowingly and voluntarily waives counsel may represent himself if competent to waive — the court may nonetheless deny self-representation to gray-area mentally ill defendants (Indiana v. Edwards); there is no right to self-representation on appeal, and no later ineffective-assistance claim. Standby counsel is permitted. Erroneous denial of a non-indigent defendant's chosen retained counsel is structural error requiring automatic reversal (Gonzalez-Lopez).
cards.aZh: 明知且自愿放弃律师的被告，只要具备放弃能力即可自我辩护——但对处于精神疾病灰色地带的被告，法院仍可拒绝其自辩（Indiana v. Edwards案）；上诉阶段无自辩权，事后也不得主张'自己辩护无效'。可指派候补律师。错误剥夺非贫困被告自费选任的律师，属结构性错误，自动撤销原判（Gonzalez-Lopez案）。
cards.explainZh: 自辩能力=受审能力即可，不要求懂法律；'他会辩砸'不是拒绝理由。选任权只保护自费律师——指定律师无选任权。结构性错误清单（无需证明影响）：选任律师被拒、Batson、自辩被拒、公开审判。

cards.q: A burglary witness, watching the TV news, recognizes Dan in footage and later identifies him at trial. Dan moves to suppress the identification as unduly suggestive. The court should:
cards.qZh: 入室盗窃案的目击证人看电视新闻时认出画面中的丹，其后在庭审中指认。丹以辨认程序过分暗示为由申请排除。法院应当：
choices: Suppress: television exposure was suggestive.
Suppress unless the prosecution proves reliability.
Deny: due-process screening applies only to police-arranged suggestive procedures (Perry).
Deny: eyewitness identifications are never suppressible.
cards.explain: Perry v. New Hampshire confines due-process challenges to suggestive circumstances arranged by law enforcement; media or private exposure goes to weight, not admissibility. When police do arrange an unnecessarily suggestive procedure, admissibility turns on the Biggers reliability factors.
cards.explainZh: 两步法只对'警方安排'启动：(1)警方安排且无必要地暗示？(2)综合Biggers因素（观察机会、注意程度、描述准确性、确信度、间隔时间）仍可靠则可采。本题是媒体曝光→直接不启动。另记：正式指控后的真人列队是关键阶段有律师权(Wade)，照片辨认无(Ash)。

cards.q: Speedy-trial claims are weighed under Barker v. Wingo's four factors: {{c::length of delay, reason for delay, defendant's assertion of the right, and prejudice}} — and the only remedy is dismissal with prejudice.
cards.qZh: 迅速审判主张依Barker v. Wingo案的四项因素衡量：____——唯一救济是不得再诉的驳回。
cards.a: length of delay, reason for delay, defendant's assertion of the right, and prejudice
cards.aZh: 迟延时长、迟延原因、被告是否主张该权利、以及所受损害
cards.explainZh: 权利自逮捕或起诉起算，此前的侦查拖延不算（靠追诉时效管）。救济是彻底驳回不得再诉——所以法院适用谨慎。对比中国《刑诉法》明定办案期限（如一审通常2-3个月），美国用弹性平衡而非硬期限。
cards.mnemonic: Barker: Length, Reason, Assertion, Prejudice

cards.q: Criminal jury rights: size, unanimity, fair cross-section, and Batson.
cards.qZh: 刑事陪审团权利:人数、一致裁决、公平截面与Batson规则。
cards.a: At least six jurors (Ballew); six-member juries must be unanimous (Burch); Ramos requires unanimous verdicts for serious offenses in state courts. Fair cross-section applies to the venire, not the petit jury (Taylor). Batson: prima facie showing of a discriminatory peremptory strike, then a neutral explanation, then the court rules on pretext; applies to race and sex, prosecution and defense alike.
cards.aZh: 陪审团至少六人（Ballew案）；六人陪审团必须一致裁决（Burch案）；Ramos v. Louisiana案要求各州对严重犯罪作一致裁决。'公平截面'要求适用于候选陪审员总库，而非最终陪审团（Taylor案）。Batson规则：初步证明无因回避存在歧视后，举证责任转移至提出中立解释，再由法院判断是否借口。适用于种族与性别，控辩双方均受约束。
cards.explainZh: 陪审权门槛：可判监禁6个月以上的'严重犯罪'。Ramos(2020)终结了州法院10-2定罪。Batson三步舞：初步证明→中立理由→借口审查；'他住的街区不好'常被认定借口。中国人民陪审员制度是参审制，与英美陪审团结构迥异。
cards.caNote: California guarantees 12 jurors and a unanimous verdict in all criminal trials, felony and misdemeanor alike.
cards.caNoteZh: 加州保障所有刑事审判（重罪与轻罪）均由12人陪审团一致裁决。

cards.q: Confrontation Clause: the Crawford framework, primary-purpose test, and forfeiture.
cards.qZh: 对质条款：Crawford框架、'首要目的'检验与权利丧失。
cards.a: Testimonial hearsay is inadmissible unless the declarant is unavailable and there was a prior opportunity for cross-examination (Crawford). Primary purpose: statements meeting an ongoing emergency (911 call, Davis; wounded victim naming his shooter, Bryant) are nontestimonial; statements establishing past facts for prosecution are testimonial. Forfeiture requires conduct intended to prevent testimony (Giles). Compulsory process guarantees obtaining defense witnesses.
cards.aZh: 证言性传闻不得用于指控被告，除非陈述人无法到庭且被告曾有交叉询问机会（Crawford案）。首要目的检验：为应对进行中紧急状况的陈述——911报警（Davis案）、濒死被害人指认枪手（Bryant案）——非证言性；为追诉而确认过去事实的陈述属证言性。以不法行为丧失对质权，须有专门阻止证人作证的意图（Giles案）。强制程序条款另行保障辩方取得证人的权力。
cards.explainZh: 分析顺序：先问证言性？再问到庭？曾否交叉询问？杀害证人≠自动丧失对质权——须证明'为灭口而杀'(Giles)。中国刑诉证人出庭率低、书面证言常规使用，对质条款是中美审判结构最大反差之一。

cards.q: The analyst who tested seized powder has left the lab. At trial, a substitute expert testifies the powder is heroin, relaying the absent analyst's report as the basis for his opinion. Under Smith v. Arizona (2024), this is:
cards.qZh: 检验涉案粉末的化验员已离职。庭审中替代专家作证称粉末为海洛因，并转述缺席化验员的报告作为其意见基础。依Smith v. Arizona案（2024），这属于：
choices: A Confrontation Clause violation if the report is testimonial: basis statements are offered for their truth.
Proper: experts may always rely on inadmissible material under evidence rules.
Proper: lab reports are nontestimonial business records.
A violation that is cured by cross-examining the substitute expert.
cards.explain: Smith v. Arizona held that when an expert relays an absent analyst's statements to support his opinion, those statements are offered for their truth, so the Confrontation Clause applies if they are testimonial — continuing the Melendez-Diaz/Bullcoming line. Rule 703 'basis' framing no longer evades confrontation, and crossing the surrogate is no substitute.
cards.explainZh: Smith(2024)封堵了'专家意见基础'后门：转述即主张其为真，Crawford照常适用。「专家总可依赖不可采材料」一项是证据法与宪法的混淆——703规则让位于对质条款；「非证言性商业记录」一项与Melendez-Diaz相反（为诉讼制作的化验证书是证言性的）；「盘问替代专家即可治愈」一项正是Bullcoming否定的'替身作证'。

cards.q: At a joint trial, non-testifying Ed's confession is admitted stating that he 'and someone else' robbed the store, with a limiting instruction; nothing in the phrasing obviously points to co-defendant Dan. Under Bruton and Samia, this is:
cards.qZh: 共同审判中，不出庭作证的埃德的供述被采纳，内容称他'和另一个人'抢劫了商店，法官作了限制性指示；措辞并未明显指向共同被告丹。依Bruton与Samia案，这属于：
choices: A violation: any co-defendant confession requires severance.
A violation: redactions can never cure a Bruton problem.
A violation precisely because a limiting instruction was given.
No violation: a neutral redaction plus a limiting instruction suffices when the confession does not obviously refer to the defendant.
cards.explain: Bruton bars a non-testifying co-defendant's confession that facially incriminates the defendant; obvious deletions or blanks still violate (Gray), but rewording that eliminates any obvious reference, coupled with a limiting instruction, is permissible (Richardson; Samia, 2023).
cards.explainZh: 光谱记忆：点名道姓=违宪(Bruton)；'某某(涂黑)'=仍违宪(Gray)；'另一个人'+限制指示=合宪(Richardson/Samia 2023)。「一律须分案」与「涂改绝不能治愈」两项过度延伸；「给了限制指示反而违宪」一项逻辑颠倒——限制指示正是合宪的必要配件。

cards.q: Brady and Giglio disclosure duties.
cards.qZh: Brady与Giglio证据开示义务。
cards.a: Due process requires the prosecution to disclose evidence that is (1) favorable — exculpatory or impeaching, including deals with witnesses (Giglio) — and (2) material: a reasonable probability disclosure would have produced a different result. Good or bad faith is irrelevant, and police knowledge is imputed to the prosecution (Kyles). Remedy: a new trial.
cards.aZh: 正当程序要求检方开示以下证据：(1)有利于被告——无罪证据或弹劾证据，包括与证人达成的交易和承诺（Giglio案）；(2)具有实质性：若开示，结果有合理可能性不同。检察官的善意或恶意无关紧要，警方掌握的信息归于检方（Kyles案）。救济为重新审判。
cards.explainZh: Brady是宪法义务，与证据开示规则并行且不可豁免；'警察知道=检方知道'防止装傻。对比中国检察机关的客观义务（应当收集有利被告证据）理念相通，但Brady有'实质性+新审判'的明确牙齿。
cards.mnemonic: Brady: Favorable + Material, faith irrelevant

cards.q: In exchange for Gil's guilty plea, the prosecutor promises to make no sentencing recommendation. At sentencing, a different prosecutor urges the maximum term. Gil's remedy?
cards.qZh: 作为吉尔认罪的交换条件，检察官承诺不提量刑建议。量刑时另一位检察官却力主顶格刑。吉尔的救济是？
choices: None: sentencing judges are never bound by recommendations anyway.
Specific performance of the bargain or plea withdrawal, at the court's option (Santobello).
Automatic dismissal of all charges.
Civil damages against the prosecutor's office.
cards.explain: Santobello: breach of a plea agreement entitles the defendant to specific performance (resentencing before a different judge with the promise kept) or withdrawal of the plea — the court chooses the remedy. A valid plea also requires a Boykin colloquy showing a voluntary, intelligent waiver with understanding of the charge and direct consequences.
cards.explainZh: 检方毁约≠无事发生：救济二选一由法院定夺(Santobello)。「反正法官不受建议约束」一项混淆'法官不受建议约束'与'检方必须履约'两回事；「自动撤销全部指控」与「民事索赔」两项均非认可救济。认罪必备Boykin对话：明知放弃陪审、对质、不自证己罪三权+理解指控与直接后果（最高刑、强制最低刑）。

cards.q: Constitutional limits at sentencing: the Apprendi line and the Eighth Amendment.
cards.qZh: 量刑的宪法限制:Apprendi规则线与第八修正案。
cards.a: Any fact except prior convictions increasing the statutory maximum authorized by the jury's findings (Apprendi/Blakely) or a mandatory minimum (Alleyne) goes to the jury beyond a reasonable doubt. Eighth Amendment: no execution of the intellectually disabled (Atkins) or juveniles (Roper); no juvenile LWOP for non-homicide (Graham), none mandatory (Miller); otherwise gross disproportionality only (Harmelin); Timbs applies excessive fines to states.
cards.aZh: 除前科外，任何提高法定最高刑（Apprendi案；Blakely案：以陪审团认定事实所能支持的最高刑为准）或强制最低刑（Alleyne案）的事实，都必须由陪审团以排除合理怀疑标准认定。第八修正案：不得对智力障碍者（Atkins案）或犯罪时未满18岁者（Roper案）适用死刑；未成年人非杀人罪不得判终身不得假释（Graham案）；不得对未成年人强制判处终身不得假释（Miller案）；对监禁刑仅作'严重失衡'审查（Harmelin案）；过度罚金条款约束各州（Timbs案）。
cards.explainZh: Apprendi口诀：抬高刑罚上限或下限的事实=犯罪要件，归陪审团。8A未成年人三部曲(Roper/Graham/Miller)按'死刑→非杀人LWOP→强制LWOP'递进记。中国死刑同样排除犯罪时未满18周岁者（刑法49条），可对照。
cards.mnemonic: Apprendi/Alleyne: raise the ceiling OR the floor → jury, BRD

cards.q: May the court restrict a testifying defendant's consultation with counsel during a recess?
cards.qZh: 被告作证中途休庭时，法院可否限制其与律师商谈？
cards.a: A complete ban on attorney consultation during an OVERNIGHT recess violates the Sixth Amendment (Geders), but a complete ban during a BRIEF recess within testimony is permissible (Perry v. Leeke). Villarreal v. Texas (2026): a QUALIFIED order during an overnight recess — barring only discussion of the defendant's ongoing testimony itself while permitting consultation on other topics (strategy, plea, sentencing) — is constitutional.
cards.aZh: 整夜休庭期间全面禁止被告与律师商谈违反第六修正案（Geders案）；作证中的短暂休庭期间全面禁止则合宪（Perry v. Leeke案）。Villarreal v. Texas（2026）：整夜休庭下的'限定式'命令——仅禁止讨论被告正在进行的证言本身、允许就策略、认罪协商、量刑等其他事项商谈——合宪。
cards.explainZh: 三分法：整夜·全面禁止＝违宪；短暂·全面禁止＝合宪；整夜·限定禁止（只禁'辅导证言'）＝合宪（2026年新判例）。原理：被告站上证人席即如普通证人，法庭可防证言在休庭中被'加工'，但不能切断其他辩护沟通。
cards.mnemonic: Overnight total ✗ · brief total ✓ · overnight qualified ✓ (Villarreal 2026)

cards.q: Prop 8 'truth in evidence': the exam-ready checklist for California criminal cases.
cards.qZh: 八号提案'证据求真'条款：加州刑事案件的答题清单。
cards.a: In criminal cases all relevant evidence is admissible notwithstanding contrary Evidence Code rules, EXCEPT exclusions under: (1) the US Constitution; (2) the hearsay rule; (3) privileges; (4) CEC 352; (5) rape-shield limits on a victim's sexual conduct (782/1103); (6) the secondary evidence rule; (7) statutes passed after 1982 by two-thirds of each house. Close with 352 balancing.
cards.aZh: 刑事案件中，所有相关证据不受《证据法典》相反规则限制均可采纳，但下列除外：(1)美国宪法排除的证据；(2)传闻规则；(3)特免权；(4)CEC 352裁量排除；(5)对性犯罪被害人性行为的强奸盾牌限制（CEC 782/1103）；(6)次级证据规则；(7)1982年后经两院三分之二多数通过的制定法。答题最后务必回到CEC 352权衡。
cards.explainZh: 论文模板：先按普通证据规则分析→若在刑事案件中被排除→问Prop 8是否救活→逐项过七个例外→最后352兜底。Prop 8只适用于刑事审判，还使被告一切重罪前科可用于弹劾（仍受352限制）、被告攻击被害人品格后检方可反击。
cards.mnemonic: Prop 8 survivors: Constitution, Hearsay, Privilege, 352, Rape shield, Secondary evidence, 2/3 statutes

cards.q: California felony charging: the two routes from arrest to trial.
cards.qZh: 加州重罪起诉：从逮捕到审判的两条路径。
cards.a: Route 1: felony complaint → arraignment → preliminary hearing before a magistrate (probable-cause screen; for in-custody defendants, within 10 court days) → if held to answer, an information is filed in superior court, reviewable by a §995 motion to set aside. Route 2: grand jury indictment, which proceeds directly to arraignment with no preliminary hearing. Trial follows arraignment on the information or indictment.
cards.aZh: 路径一：重罪告发状→提讯→治安法官主持预审（合理根据审查；在押被告须于10个法庭日内举行）→裁定移送后，向高等法院提交检察官起诉书，可依第995条动议申请撤销。路径二：大陪审团起诉书，直接进入提讯，无需预审。在起诉书提讯后进入审判。
cards.explainZh: 预审是加州特色的司法过滤器：检察官起诉走预审，大陪审团起诉可绕开（Prop 115后无需补办预审）。995动议=对预审裁定的'上诉'。中国由检察院审查起诉、无中立法官过滤，程序哲学不同。

cards.q: A California criminal verdict requires {{c::12 jurors and unanimity}}; since Ramos v. Louisiana, unanimity for serious offenses is also a federal constitutional command in every state.
cards.qZh: 加州刑事裁决要求____；自Ramos v. Louisiana案后，对严重犯罪的一致裁决也已成为约束各州的联邦宪法要求。
cards.a: 12 jurors and unanimity
cards.aZh: 12名陪审员一致裁决
cards.explainZh: 加州宪法向来要求12人+一致（轻罪亦然，双方合意可减员）；Ramos把'一致'升格为全国规则。僵局陪审团=流审，可重审不违反双重危险。

cards.q: California reciprocal discovery under Proposition 115.
cards.qZh: 加州115号提案下的双向证据开示。
cards.a: Two-way discovery. The defense must disclose trial witnesses' names, addresses, and statements, expert reports, and real evidence it will introduce, at least 30 days before trial; the prosecution discloses its witnesses, statements, real evidence, witnesses' felony records, and all exculpatory evidence. Upheld against self-incrimination challenge (Izazaga). Sanctions: continuance, contempt, adverse instructions, but never preclusion of the defendant's own testimony.
cards.aZh: 证据开示是双向的。辩方须在审判前至少30日开示：拟传证人姓名住址、证人陈述、专家报告及拟出示的实物证据；检方须开示其证人、陈述、实物证据、证人重罪前科及全部无罪证据。该制度经受住了不自证己罪的挑战（Izazaga案）。制裁包括延期、藐视法庭和不利指示；但不得禁止被告本人作证。
cards.explainZh: '辩方也要交底'是Prop 115的革命——但只涉及拟在庭上使用的材料，不碰工作成果与被告陈述本身，故合宪。检方的Brady义务不受30天限制，随时到手随时交。

cards.q: California officers seize evidence in a search that violates a California statute but fully complies with the Fourth Amendment. In a California criminal trial, the evidence is:
cards.qZh: 加州警察的搜查违反了加州某制定法，但完全符合第四修正案。在加州刑事审判中，该证据：
choices: Suppressed: state law governs state prosecutions.
Suppressed under the independent-state-grounds doctrine of the California Constitution.
Admissible: Prop 8 abolished independent state-law suppression; only federal constitutional violations compel exclusion (In re Lance W.).
Admissible for impeachment only.
cards.explain: After Proposition 8, California courts may suppress evidence only when the United States Constitution requires it (In re Lance W.); violations of state statutes or the state constitution alone no longer trigger exclusion.
cards.explainZh: 加州排除法则=联邦地板，不多不少：州法违规本身不排证据（可能另有行政或民事后果）。「州法管州诉」与「独立州宪依据」两项描述的是Prop 8之前的旧格局；「仅可用于弹劾」一项无根据。论文答题凡涉排除，先说联邦标准，再补一句'依Prop 8加州仅执行联邦最低要求'。
